name: omniscient/omnibank
description: Omnibank: one contract for bank access - accounts, balances, transactions, transfers, consents and webhooks - over statement files and bank APIs, and its Symfony bundle (Omnitrade's sibling for banking).

suggest.omnibank/files: Statement files: CAMT.053, OFX, CSV read; SEPA credit transfers written as pain.001
suggest.omnibank/qonto: Qonto: accounts, balances and transactions with an API key
suggest.omnibank/powens: Powens (ex Budget Insight): bank aggregation through its Webview, webhooks
suggest.omnibank/bridge: Bridge (bridgeapi.io): bank aggregation through its Connect sessions, webhooks
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnibank\Bridge\Symfony\OmnibankBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnibank\Bridge\Symfony\OmnibankBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnibank\Bridge\Symfony\OmnibankBundle itself
